key_fields.name: ABEND-DATA
key_fields.meaning: 134-byte block sent to the terminal by ABEND-ROUTINE before the task abends.

key_fields.name: ABEND-CODE
key_fields.meaning: 4-character program abend code; COACTUPC sets '0001' for an unexpected state.

key_fields.name: ABEND-CULPRIT
key_fields.meaning: Name of the program raising the abend (COACTUPC).

key_fields.name: ABEND-REASON
key_fields.meaning: 50-byte reason text; set to spaces by COACTUPC.

key_fields.name: ABEND-MSG
key_fields.meaning: 72-byte abend message, for example 'UNEXPECTED DATA SCENARIO'; defaulted to 'UNEXPECTED ABEND OCCURRED.' when empty.

observations.text: The header comment names the member CABENDD.CPY, not CSMSG02Y; lines 1-4 and 21-29 carry sequence numbers while the licence block does not.

purpose: Defines ABEND-DATA, the work area for the common abend routine: abend code, culprit program, reason and message. COACTUPC fills it for an unexpected change-action state and in ABEND-ROUTINE sends it to the terminal before EXEC CICS ABEND ABCODE('9999'). It is also copied by other CardDemo online programs.
